method: Inspected all source pages for context and every candidate at native pixel resolution, including each of its four edges. Additional doubled source details checked exercise 13 title, example 381 lowest figure, and example 392 title/handwriting boundary. All 55 images have identical mode, dimensions and decoded pixel bytes to the declared source crop. All 55 source paths, PDF indices and source dimensions agree with sources/index.json. Coordinates are original source pixels, [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive. No retouching, border generation or candidate changes performed.
pass_criteria: PASS means intended content complete, number/variant/attribution/title/lyrics/analysis retained where printed, staff ends and extreme notation intact, genuine feasible source margins, and no prose/page number/foreign fragment/handwriting on any edge or within the crop. Isolated source specks are not treated as characters or handwriting. The continuation of exercise 15 and variant 409b have no repeated number in the source; their paired images supply identification.

blank_page.result: Visually blank apart from scan specks; no missing musical example.
